description: Find the Litescrape tools for a task beyond the ones listed here: AI answers, maps details and reviews, app stores, retailers, real estate, jobs, social media, web pages and more. Describe the task in q to get the best matches first, or pass names to fetch specific tools. Each tool comes with its description and whether it works without an API key; best matches and named tools also carry their input schema. Run one with call_tool.

limit.description: Most tools to return for q; default 5

names.description: Tool names to fetch with their input schemas, instead of q

q.description: The task, in plain language, e.g. "track competitor prices on Amazon"

name: find_tools
title: Find Litescrape tools
